title: RIG Design Studio dev-handoff v1.1 — the measurement spine
description: v1.1 ADDS pageIndex to v1. It deletes nothing. The reason for the bump: v1 exported cards, counts, deviations and a token set, but no stable identity for a page, so no measurement taken after launch could ever find its way back to the board card it came from. pageIndex is that key. Every other tool in the lifecycle joins on `url`.

x-version-policy.rule: A version bump ADDS assertions and never deletes old ones. v1 exports stay checkable as long as they can be produced.
x-version-policy.consumers-keying-on: rig.design-studio.dev-handoff.v1.1 (accepts .v1 payloads; .v1 consumers should ignore unknown top-level keys)

provenance.description: NEW. v1 declared the token set by hand. v1.1 records where it came from so rigds-token-pipeline can prove the built tokens match the handoff.

phases.description: v1 shipped 4 (Discover/Define/Develop/Deliver). v1.1 accepts the full 7-phase Double Black Box: discover, define, gate, diverge, develop, deliver, measure.

url.description: NEW. The join key. null on cards that are not pages (a persona, a decision, a risk).

pageIndex.description: THE SPINE. One row per page in the system. The Screaming Frog / Ahrefs / GSC / GA4 / PostHog / CMS rows all join on `url`; this array is where they land. It is also how a measurement taken 3 months post-launch finds the card it belongs to.

cardId.description: Must resolve to a real card in cards[].

metric.description: One primary metric per page. Exactly one. A page with two primary metrics has no primary metric.

baseline.description: Measured BEFORE the design change. null = never baselined, which is a gap and is reported as one.

source.description: Provenance of the last measurement, e.g. 'ga4:organic' or 'posthog:funnel-home'. Untrusted data never lands here without a source.

evidence.description: Command outputs and artifact hashes, same discipline as the ProofPacket. A measured number with no evidence path is not a measurement.

x-new-assertions-for-export-check: every pageIndex[].cardId resolves to a real card in cards[]
every card with a non-null url appears exactly once in pageIndex
pageIndex[].evidence[] entries carry kind + ref; an entry with measured != null has at least one evidence entry
tokenSet.provenance.source is present (a hand-declared token set is legal but must say so out loud)
all 7 phase ids present in phases[] (a 4-phase export is allowed but must carry an explicit legacy flag)
